# Chatwork

Chatwork is a team communication platform featuring group chats, file sharing, and task management, aiming to enhance collaboration and productivity for businesses

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/chatwork/.

## Actions

- **Delete Message**: This tool allows you to delete a specific message from a chatwork room by calling the delete endpoint at https.
- **Get Chatwork Contacts** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all contacts from chatwork.
- **Get Chatwork File** (read-only): This tool retrieves information about a specific file in a chat room.
- **Get My Chatwork Status** (read-only): This tool retrieves the current status of the authenticated user, including unread message counts and task status.
- **Upload File to Chatwork Room**: This tool allows users to upload files to a specific chatwork room.
- **Get Chatwork Rooms** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all chat rooms associated with the authenticated chatwork account.
- **Get Room Members** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all members in a specified chatwork room using the endpoint get /rooms/{room id}/members.
- **Get Room Messages** (read-only): This tool retrieves messages from a specific chatwork room using the get https.
